Heya, fans of the apocalypse!

On reddit, the "cyberpunk" sub acted as a catch-all for anything remotely related to the theme. It was a sub packed with content of all sorts, with new stuff being submitted constantly. I was always frustrated that there was nothing as good as that for post-apocalyptic themes. You had to subscribe to, "postapocalypse", "apocalypse", "chernobyl", "apocalypseporn", etc. And still, the content only trickled in. I'm hoping to cultivate a single subverse with the quality and flow of content that /r/cyperpunk had, but for the best theme of all: Post-Apocalypse! So if you have content that relates to this theme, it would be great if you x-posted it to /v/postapocalypse, if not put it here to begin with.

I love all things apocalyptic, and I'm trying to grow a single subverse to support the theme. It just works better that way, without being sub-divided and fragmented. Thank-you!
